name: Healing Totem
description: Heals the player for 5 HP every 1 second within 2.5 tiles, lasts 15s.

name: Mana Spring Totem
description: Restores 8 mana every 1 second within 2.5 tiles, lasts 15s.

name: Searing Totem
description: Deals 12 damage to enemies within 2.0 tiles, every 0.5s. Up to 8 triggers, 12s cap.

name: Tremor Totem
description: Stuns enemies within 2.5 tiles for 1 turn. Up to 3 triggers, 10s cap.
